explication: Mixlab is a ComfyUI custom-node extension for building creative workflows and publishing selected workflows as web apps. The principal path is a user configuring a ComfyUI graph, running image, prompt, media, or 3D nodes, and viewing or saving results; the web-app mode exposes configured workflow inputs and outputs in a browser. The graph includes documented capabilities whose detailed implementations were not sampled. Edges are limited to README statements and source-index references; unsampled integrations are left unconnected where their wiring is uncertain.
